Create an ORIGINAL chibi pixel RPG concept sprite sheet matching the attached approved player sheet. Real coarse square pixels, hard stepped contours, dark warm outline, broad clean flat color clusters, 2-3 tones per material, about 16-22 colors per character. No painterly rendering, gradients, antialiasing, dithering, thin lines or over-detailed embroidery. Same pixel scale and identical overall height across every figure. All figures EMPTY HANDED, no held/sheathed weapons, no skill effects, no backgrounds, no text, labels or shadows. Authentic transparent alpha background. Keep recognizable SAME uncovered face and brown hair; costume silhouette and materials distinguish jobs and advanced levels. Design original outfits, not copied named game characters. Center each figure entirely inside its own cell, generous transparent gutters, aligned heads and feet each row. Reading order:

2 Swordsman: cobalt blue compact coat, silver light shoulder plates, white sash, fitted short sleeves.
3 Guardian: slate blue chunky layered armor, broad square shoulder plates, ochre trim, sturdy tiny boots.

7 Berserker: charcoal and copper heavy cuirass, brick-red fur-lined bulky shoulders, exposed short forearms, strong rugged outline; face still original warm hero, no scars.
8 EMPTY transparent. Advanced costumes visibly evolved, not simple recolors.
